GIF, PNG, JPEG, WebP and supported image ZIPs can be imported. Downloaded files remain in private local storage.

The default link points to a temporary historical GitHub Actions artifact. Download the artifact ZIP, extract fluent3d-full-offline-collection.zip and import that inner ZIP only. Change the link if the artifact expires. The Microsoft source repository ZIP is not directly installable.

The Qwen link opens a pinned 1.6 GB LiteRT-LM model. Download it in your browser, then select Import manually, open Qwen LiteRT and import .litertlm. The separately installed runtime must have the same signing certificate as FUTO. MediaPipe .task and KeyboardLM GGUF are different formats.
